name: PUBH 5502
title: Epidemiology of Disability
description: Introduces epidemiologic research design and delves deeply into epidemiology as it applies to monitoring the health status of people with disabilities, diagnosing and investigating health problems, evaluating personal and population-based interventions, and conduct of research as uniquely affecting and affected by disability.  Critically examines sources of public health and epidemiologic data that exist.
requirement_description: PUBH 5501; open only Disability Studies in Public Health certificate students, others by instructor consent.
